openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: series of miniature routers based on the MediaTek MT7620n with two Ethernet ports and a 802.11n 2T/2R 2.4 GHz 300Mbps wireless interface

Modelltabelle.WT3020A: USB No, Flash 4 MB, Wireless router
Modelltabelle.WT3020H: USB Yes, Flash 8 MB, Wireless router with USB port
Modelltabelle.WT3020F: USB Yes, Flash 8 MB, Wireless router with USB port and 3G dongle support
Modelltabelle.WT3020F (³): USB Yes, Flash 8 MB, different hardware model
Modelltabelle.WT3020AD: USB Yes, Flash 8 MB, Wireless router with USB port, 3G dongle support and extra features
Modelltabelle.Fußnoten: ¹ differences between WT3020H, WT3020F and WT3020AD are only found in the original firmware; ² extra features are unknown; ³ different hardware model

Hardware.Flash chip: Winbond W25Q32BV (4MB), W25Q64BV or cFeon Q64-104HIP or 25Q64FVSIG (8MB)
Hardware.USB: No / 1 x USB 2.0 host (A-type) (depending on model)

openwrt_wiki.Serial connection: accessed using the TTL pins shown in the image; voltage level converter (CP2102 TTL-USB) required; 57600 bps 8N1
openwrt_wiki.Identifying the device: On the WT3020H model (8 MB flash), the Ethernet MAC starts with 20:28:18:...
openwrt_wiki.GPIO: GPIOs 0, 2, 18, and 19 are exposed on the board, connected to pull-down resistors
openwrt_wiki.Known problems: certain U-Boot versions reported problematic (possible brick, ticket 19570); factory firmware initial upgrade reported non-working 'Bad Magic Number' (ticket 19983); failsafe reported non-working (ticket 18768), again with WT3020F new hardware model on 15.05rc3
openwrt_wiki.Installation: factory.bin via stock web UI http://192.168.8.1 (admin/admin), System Setting -> Upgrade Firmware; Seite beschreibt außerdem Bootloader-Ersatz (nicht übernommen)
openwrt_wiki.Factory: mtd2 calibration data, MAC at offset 4; eth0.2 = MAC+1
openwrt_wiki.Network: WAN port (towards the edge of the PCB) is eth0.2 (switch port 0)
openwrt_wiki.Original firmware: WAN port next to the edge of the board, DHCP client; Ralink UBoot Version 4.1.0.0 (stock) / 4.1.1.0; Linux 2.6.36
openwrt_wiki.Bootlog U-Boot: DRAM: 64 MB; DRAM component: 512 Mbits DDR, width 16; DRAM bus 16 bit
openwrt_wiki.PoE mod: Umbau: Pins 4/5 und 7/8 abtrennen, DC-DC 5-17 V -> 5 V, Umschalter; 'NEXX ITSELF HAS 1.2 ADC'; 5 V von Micro-USB und USB-A verbunden
openwrt_wiki.Flash-Erweiterung: Tausch des SPI-Flash gegen 8/16/32 MB (en25Q64/W25Q64/MX25L128/MX25L256) beschrieben
